title: THE WARDEN REDESIGN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of all characters and machines, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders, silhouettes first. The Warden was a purple dustbin on treads with a yellow letterbox, purple is the elite colour, its hull never turned and its tread hardly moved. It is now a hunched walker-tank in gunmetal with rust-red armour plates: tracks whose links run as it moves, a low visor slit that glows dim white at rest, amber when it investigates, red when it hunts and orange when it vents, a cannon arm on a hydraulic piston, a launcher pod and exhaust stacks on its back, and the whole hull turns to face you. Elite Wardens wear brass trim and a brass antenna. Drawn only: its size, its weak points and the fight are unchanged.
now: The Warden is redrawn: a hunched gunmetal walker-tank with rust plates, a cannon arm and a visor that shows its mood.
